text.sanctum.hearthford.name: The Silt-Chancel
text.sanctum.hearthford.theme: flooded measures and forgotten grain vows
text.sanctum.hearthford.witness.name: Mera Silt, travelling measurer
text.sanctum.hearthford.boss.name: the Silt Abbot
text.sanctum.hearthford.boss.capability: drains a flooded lane before pressing with a spear
text.sanctum.hearthford.boss.counterplay: Floodwater isolates a pursuer; a denied drain stalls the advance.
text.sanctum.greywash.name: The Salt Reliquary
text.sanctum.greywash.theme: wreck titles and salt-caked oath tablets
text.sanctum.greywash.witness.name: Tova Shoal, salvage witness
text.sanctum.greywash.boss.name: the Chain Prelate
text.sanctum.greywash.boss.capability: signals a roof escort before firing across an open lane
text.sanctum.greywash.boss.counterplay: A separated escort loses the signal's protection; chamber walls break the firing lane.
text.sanctum.greenwold.name: The Cinder Choir
text.sanctum.greenwold.witness.name: Iva Root, refuge keeper
text.sanctum.greenwold.boss.name: the Ash Cantor
text.sanctum.greenwold.boss.capability: kindles carried roof fuel while circling the stalls
text.sanctum.greenwold.boss.counterplay: wet the fuel or leave the warned lane
text.sanctum.whitecairn.name: The Bell Crypt
text.sanctum.whitecairn.witness.name: Orla Bell, road sounder
text.sanctum.whitecairn.boss.name: the Bell Warden
text.sanctum.whitecairn.boss.capability: marks a weakened roof support and denies the stair with a net
text.sanctum.whitecairn.boss.counterplay: brace the support or move through the second doorway
text.sanctum.dunmire.name: The Peat Lantern
text.sanctum.dunmire.theme: raised refuge and drowned fuel claims
text.sanctum.dunmire.witness.name: Rhea Fen, peat reckoner
text.sanctum.dunmire.boss.name: the Fen Lantern
text.sanctum.dunmire.boss.capability: drains its own flooded gallery before firing
text.sanctum.dunmire.boss.counterplay: use wet cover or interrupt the drainage
text.sanctum.rillscar.name: The Two-Span Ossuary
text.sanctum.rillscar.theme: bridge tolls and unburied quarry debt
text.sanctum.rillscar.witness.name: Hale Span, bridge witness
text.sanctum.rillscar.boss.name: the Span Collector
text.sanctum.rillscar.boss.capability: braces a failing crossing while sheltering its guard
text.sanctum.rillscar.boss.counterplay: separate the guard or take the alternate span
text.sanctum.marlbank.name: The Kiln Testament
text.sanctum.marlbank.theme: seed water and fired clay promises
text.sanctum.marlbank.witness.name: Nemi Kiln, clay adjudicator
text.sanctum.marlbank.boss.name: the Kiln Adjudicator
text.sanctum.marlbank.boss.capability: lights stored kiln fuel before closing the aisle
text.sanctum.marlbank.boss.counterplay: quench the fuel or cross behind the partition
text.sanctum.frostmere.name: The Ice-Sound Chapel
text.sanctum.frostmere.theme: winter soundings and false channel lights
text.sanctum.frostmere.witness.name: Sela Ice, channel witness
text.sanctum.frostmere.boss.name: the Soundless Pilot
text.sanctum.frostmere.boss.capability: spends carried dressings on a roof escort while sighting the channel
text.sanctum.frostmere.boss.counterplay: An isolated escort cannot be tended; a close doorway denies the long sightline.
text.sanctum.witness.existing: {witness} still keeps a physical witness position by the shrine; speak from beside them with E.
text.sanctum.witness.unavailable: A travelling witness reached the site, but the shrine's working ground is occupied.
text.sanctum.witness.arrival: {witness} arrives at {x},{y} to record the site. Speak beside them with E.
text.sanctum.encounter.limit: Old tracks cross the gallery, but no new party arrives.
text.sanctum.encounter.occupied: A fresh trail reaches the shrine, but no creature can take the occupied approach.
text.sanctum.encounter.none: The tracks leave the site without a creature to follow them.
text.sanctum.encounter.arrival: A {actor} takes the approach at {x},{y}; its {goal} is visible before contact.
text.sanctum.enter.tier: {sanctum} opens in divided tiers. A warder and named keeper hold the upper route.
text.sanctum.undercroft.already: The undercroft seal has already been carried upstairs.
text.sanctum.undercroft.no_space: The old seal is watched, but the cave gives no space for the warder to emerge.
text.sanctum.undercroft.spawned: A buried warder answers the inscription. Defeat or evade it, then read the seal again.
text.sanctum.undercroft.contested: The buried warder still contests the inscription.
text.sanctum.undercroft.opened: You copy the undercroft measure; the sanctum stair's seal releases.
text.sanctum.secret.none: No scored gallery seam is here.
text.sanctum.secret.open: The gallery shortcut is already open.
text.sanctum.secret.opened: The scored stone turns aside. A second route through the ward gallery opens.
text.sanctum.inspect.offer: O. Offer one physical faction dependency lot; improve the shared account and open the stair (once).
text.sanctum.inspect.breach: B. Break the seal without a lot; open the stair, but incur a witnessed obligation (once).
text.sanctum.inspect.study: S. Study the inscription and the current encounter. Escape leaves the shrine.
text.sanctum.inspect.secret: A scored seam lies in the ward gallery near {x},{y},z+1; stand on its mark and press E.
text.sanctum.inspect.aftermath: Aftermath: {control}; the next visit can change who holds the gallery.
text.sanctum.inspect.shelter: H. At a network-held, cleared site, ask its witness to open the existing one-time route shelter; this records one obligation.
text.sanctum.choice.account_unavailable: The travelling institution account is not ready here.
text.sanctum.choice.shelter_unavailable: Only a cleared site held by its travelling network can open a route shelter.
text.sanctum.choice.shelter_witness: No regional witness represents this route account.
text.sanctum.choice.offered: This shrine has already accepted one witnessed offering.
text.sanctum.choice.requirement: Bring one physical {commodity} lot in the courier's pack.
text.sanctum.choice.offering: The physical {commodity} is witnessed. {account} trust rises and the stair opens across its paired regions.
text.sanctum.choice.breach_unavailable: The seal is already open; there is nothing left to break.
text.sanctum.choice.breach_memory: {courier} broke the {sanctum} seal without an account.
text.sanctum.choice.breach: The seal breaks. {account} records the breach; future site encounters grow less sheltered.
text.sanctum.choice.invalid: Choose Offer, Break, Study, or a held-site shelter.
text.sanctum.event.quiet_witnesses: Quiet witnesses mark the way to {sanctum}; the shrine records their account.
text.sanctum.event.parcel_unavailable: A parcel's trail reaches the shrine, but the working ground holds no recoverable lot.
text.sanctum.event.parcel: A physical {commodity} parcel lies at {x},{y}; recover it with I, offer it, trade it, or leave it.
text.sanctum.event.stone: The shrine's outer stone cracks. Debris will fall in three actions; brace it or move clear.
text.sanctum.event.stone_safe: The shrine's outer stone sounds hollow, but the ground does not take a new fracture.
text.sanctum.record.cleared: {sanctum} is cleared: four credits; {strategy}. Its physical reliquary remains to be opened.
text.sanctum.record.strategy_bound: Strategy is already at its bound
text.sanctum.record.claimants_left: The last armed claimant leaves {sanctum}; its holding is {control} again.
